common.resetHint: Reset data: puts one request back in every stage.

model.serverDownWithLocal: The API is not responding. “Draft with AI” will try the browser's local model and, failing that, use the fallback text.
model.serverDownDetail: The API is not responding. “Draft with AI” will use the fallback text and the app will keep working exactly the same.
model.configuredDetail: The server has ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and will use {{model}} to draft the vacancy.
model.noKeyDetail: The server has no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. “Draft with AI” will return a description composed from the technical profile.

registro.label: Intake
registro.purpose: Sales records what the client needs and places it in a practice.

perfil.label: Profile
perfil.purpose: The Solution Architect turns the need into a concrete technical profile.

equipo.label: Team
equipo.purpose: The Delivery Manager assigns the request to a team and opens the position.

vacante.label: Vacancy
vacante.purpose: Recruiter publishes the vacancy with a usable job description.

entrevista.label: Interview
entrevista.purpose: The Engineering Manager evaluates the candidate and decides.

onboarding.label: Onboarding
onboarding.purpose: People Operations handles contract, equipment and access.

activo.label: Active
activo.purpose: The consultant is working in the team.

sales.name: Sales
sales.title: Account executive
capabilities: Record what the client needs
Place the request in a practice
Set the cost centre and billing model

solution-architect.name: Solution Architect
solution-architect.title: Solutions architect
capabilities: Define the technical profile
Choose a stack within the practice
Set seniority, skills and English level

delivery-manager.name: Delivery Manager
delivery-manager.title: Delivery lead
capabilities: Assign the request to a team
Open the position in the team
Set the allocation from the Teams view

recruiter.name: Recruiter
recruiter.title: Technical recruiter
capabilities: Publish the vacancy
Draft the job description with help from a model
Choose channels and salary band

engineering-manager.name: Engineering Manager
engineering-manager.title: Engineering lead
capabilities: Evaluate the candidate technically
Score them and leave written feedback
Decide on the hire

hr.name: People Operations
hr.title: People management
capabilities: Formalise the contract
Hand over the equipment
Grant access and assign a buddy

consultant.name: Consultant
consultant.title: Developer, QA or Tech Manager
capabilities: Join the team
Ramp up until productive
Be reviewed and, where it applies, rotate

client.label: Client
client.explain: The request has no client yet. Type the client's name in the “Client” field of the request form.

practice.label: Practice
practice.explain: The practice has not been chosen in the request form. Until it is, the “Technology stack” field stays empty and locked, because its options depend on it.

cost-center.label: Cost centre
cost-center.explain: The cost centre is empty. It is required to register the request even though the form does not mark it as such: without it, Finance cannot charge the consultant's hours.

explain.with-practice: The technology stack is missing. You choose it in the request form, and only the stacks belonging to the selected practice are offered.
explain.without-practice: The technology stack is missing, but it cannot be chosen while the request has no practice: the stack options depend on it.

seniority.label: Seniority
seniority.explain: The technical profile has no seniority. Set it in the Solution Architect panel; the salary band and the position opened in the team both depend on it.

role.label: Consultant role
role.explain: Nobody has said whether the request needs a developer, a QA or a tech manager. Choose the role in the Solution Architect panel.

skills.label: Skills (at least 3)
skills.explain_one: The profile has one skill selected and the minimum to publish a vacancy is 3. Add the missing ones in the Solution Architect panel.
skills.explain_other: The profile has {{count}} skills selected and the minimum to publish a vacancy is 3. Add the missing ones in the Solution Architect panel.

english.label: English level
english.explain: The English level required of the consultant is missing. It is mandatory in the technical profile because it decides which candidates Recruiter can put forward.

explain.none: The request is not assigned to a team. Choose the team in the Delivery Manager panel: doing so opens the corresponding position.
explain.missing-team: The team this request was assigned to no longer exists. Assign it again from the Delivery Manager panel.
explain.released: The request says it is in {{team}}, but there is no longer an open position for it there: it was released from the Teams view. Assign it again from the Delivery Manager panel.

join-date.label: Team start date
join-date.explain: The team start date is missing. The Delivery Manager sets it in their panel, and People Operations uses it later for the contract.

referent.label: Technical referent
referent.explain: The technical referent inside the team is missing. They are the person who supports the consultant through ramp-up, and they are named in the Delivery Manager panel.

title.label: Vacancy title
title.explain: The vacancy has no title. Write it in the Recruiter panel: it is what the candidate sees in the advert.

explain.empty: The vacancy has no job description. You can write it by hand or press “Draft with AI” to generate it from the technical profile already defined.
explain.short: The job description is {{count}} characters long and nothing under 120 gets published. Expand it by hand or press “Draft with AI” again.

channels.label: Publication channels
channels.explain: The vacancy is not published on any channel. Select at least one in the Recruiter panel.

salary-band.label: Salary band
salary-band.explain: The vacancy has no salary band. Without it, the Engineering Manager cannot close an offer after the interview.

candidate.label: Candidate evaluated
candidate.explain: No candidate is recorded for the interview. Type their name in the Engineering Manager panel: they are the person who will appear in the team afterwards.

explain.none: The interview has no technical score. Score the candidate from 0 to 10 in the Engineering Manager panel.
explain.low: The candidate scored {{score}} out of 10 and the minimum to hire is 7. Revisit the evaluation, or reject the candidate and look for another.

explain.pending: The interview decision is still “pending”. Change it to “hire” in the Engineering Manager panel to carry on.
explain.second-round: The interview is marked as “second round”. Until the decision is “hire”, People Operations cannot open the onboarding.
explain.rejected: The candidate is rejected. Record another candidate and evaluate them, or change the decision to “hire”.

explain.empty: The interview has no written feedback. Recording the basis for the evaluation is required before the case goes to People Operations.
explain.short: The interview feedback is {{count}} characters long and at least 40 are required. Explain what the decision was based on.

contract.label: Contract type
contract.explain: The contract type is missing. People Operations chooses it in their panel before registering the consultant.

equipment.label: Equipment handed over
equipment.explain: The equipment is not yet recorded as handed over. Mark it in the People Operations panel once the laptop is in the consultant's hands.

accesses.label: Access granted (at least 3)
accesses.explain_one: The consultant has one access granted and cannot start with fewer than 3. Complete them in the People Operations panel.
accesses.explain_other: The consultant has {{count}} accesses granted and cannot start with fewer than 3. Complete them in the People Operations panel.

buddy.label: Buddy assigned
buddy.explain: Nobody is listed as the consultant's buddy. Assign one in the People Operations panel: they are the person who supports them through the first two weeks.

explain.no-position: There is no open position for this request, so there is no allocation to set. Assign the request to a team again and then set the allocation in the Teams view.
explain.no-allocation: The position for this request in {{team}} has no allocation. The allocation is not set here: go to the Teams view, find the open position and give it a percentage above zero.

explain.no-team: Capacity cannot be checked because the request has no valid team assigned.
explain.over: {{team}} would be committed to {{used}} allocation points against a capacity of {{capacity}}, which is {{excess}} over. Lower the allocation of one of the team's positions in the Teams view before activating the consultant.

blocking.headline_one: Request {{code}} cannot move to the $t(stages.{{stage}}.label) stage: one requirement is still unmet.
blocking.headline_other: Request {{code}} cannot move to the $t(stages.{{stage}}.label) stage: {{count}} requirements are still unmet.
blocking.intakeHeadline_one: The request cannot be registered: one required field is missing.
blocking.intakeHeadline_other: The request cannot be registered: {{count}} required fields are missing.
blocking.alreadyFinal: Request {{code}} is already in the $t(stages.{{stage}}.label) stage, which is the last one in the flow.

aside.elsewhere_one: That one is not fixed on this screen: the position's allocation is set in the Teams view.
aside.elsewhere_other: {{count}} of them are not fixed on this screen but in the Teams view.
aside.inherited_one: It comes from an earlier stage: requirements are not closed when you move on, they keep being checked to the end.
aside.inherited_other: {{count}} come from earlier stages: requirements are not closed when you move on, they keep being checked to the end.

handoff.delivered: {{code}} moves from $t(stages.{{from}}.label) to $t(stages.{{to}}.label) and lands in $t(agents.{{toAgent}}.name)'s inbox. {{checks}} accumulated requirements were verified.
handoff.activated: {{code}} is now active. The consultant is working in the team and {{checks}} accumulated requirements were verified from the start of the flow.

events.consultantActive: {{name}} joins the team and starts ramping up.
events.alreadyFinal: {{code}} was already in the last stage.
events.allocationSet: Delivery Manager sets the allocation for {{code}} to {{pct}} points.
events.allocationCleared: Delivery Manager clears the allocation on the position for {{code}}.
events.positionReleased: The position for {{code}} was released: the request needs a team again.

draft.anthropic: Recruiter generates the description for {{code}} with {{model}}.
draft.gemini-nano: Recruiter generates the description for {{code}} with the browser's local model.
draft.reserva: Recruiter composes the description for {{code}} from the fallback text.

onboarding.label: Onboarding
onboarding.summary: Administrative setup: contract, equipment and access.

contract.label: Contract signed
contract.detail: People Operations formalises the contract type agreed in the request.

equipment.label: Equipment handed over
equipment.detail: The laptop and peripherals are in the consultant's hands.

accesses.label: Access granted
accesses.detail: At least three active accesses, including email and the client repository.

buddy.label: Buddy assigned
buddy.detail: Someone from the team supports the consultant through the first two weeks.

ramp-up.label: Ramp-up
ramp-up.summary: Getting into context until the consultant delivers without constant support.

context-session.label: Context session with the client
context-session.detail: The consultant knows the business, the product and who to ask.

first-change.label: First change in production
first-change.detail: A real delivery, however small, reviewed by the technical referent.

ramp-up-plan.label: Ramp-up plan agreed
ramp-up-plan.detail: The technical referent and the Delivery Manager set goals for the first six weeks.

productivo.label: Productive
productivo.summary: The consultant sustains the team's commitment on their own.

unsupported-sprint.label: A full sprint without the referent's support
unsupported-sprint.detail: The consultant picks up, solves and delivers their work unaided.

stable-allocation.label: Stable allocation in the team
stable-allocation.detail: The allocation set in the Teams view holds unchanged for a month.

client-feedback.label: Client feedback recorded
client-feedback.detail: The Delivery Manager collects the client's assessment in writing.

evaluacion.label: Review
evaluacion.summary: Formal performance review and a decision about what comes next.

performance-review.label: Performance review
performance-review.detail: The Engineering Manager reviews the consultant three months after they became productive.

team-feedback.label: Team feedback
team-feedback.detail: The assessment of the people who work with the consultant daily is collected.

career-plan.label: Career plan agreed
career-plan.detail: Consultant and Engineering Manager agree the next step.

salida.label: Exit or rotation
salida.summary: Closing the cycle: the consultant rotates to another team or leaves the account.

decision-recorded.label: Decision recorded
decision-recorded.detail: It is written down whether the consultant rotates to another team or leaves the account.

handover.label: Handover documented
handover.detail: The consultant's knowledge is in the team's hands before their last day.

access-revoked.label: Access revoked
access-revoked.detail: People Operations removes client access within 24 hours.

requests.title: Requests
requests.subtitle: Every request waits in one role's inbox. Open it to see what it is missing and hand it to the next role; it never moves on its own.

board.aiTooltip: The only agent that can lean on a language model, and only to draft the job description.

dialog.requirementsHint: Handing over to $t(agents.{{agent}}.name) checks {{count}} requirements, including those from earlier stages.
dialog.finalNote: The consultant is already working in the team.
dialog.noneRequired: This stage requires nothing: the request is at the end of the flow.

create.title: Register a request
create.description: Sales records what the client needs. The request enters the Intake stage and does not move until someone moves it by hand.

blockers.title: What is holding the flow up
blockers.summary: {{count}} unmet requirements, grouped by the stage that asks for them.
blockers.explanation: Because requirements accumulate, an early stage can keep holding up requests that are already near the end.
blockers.empty: Nothing is unmet: every request could move on.
blockers.tooltip_one: One requirement asked for by the $t(stages.{{stage}}.label) stage is still unmet.
blockers.tooltip_other: {{count}} requirements asked for by the $t(stages.{{stage}}.label) stage are still unmet.
blockers.tableToggle: See the data as a table

trace.title: Orchestration trace
trace.summary: {{count}} handoffs between agents, with what was verified in each one.

toast.createdDetail: The request lands in Sales' inbox, in the Intake stage.
toast.resetDetail: There is one request in every stage of the flow again.
toast.releasedDetail: The request needs a team again: the Team stage requirement stops being met.
toast.draftFallback: Description composed from the fallback text
toast.draftDone: The description is now on the vacancy.
toast.draftFailed: The description could not be drafted
toast.draftFailedDetail: Write it by hand in the Recruiter panel to carry on.

form.clientPlaceholder: Name of the company making the request
form.practiceHint: Decides which stacks can be chosen in the next field.
form.stackHintReady: Only the stacks of the chosen practice are offered.
form.stackHintBlocked: Choose a practice first: its options depend on it.
form.stackBlocked: Locked until a practice is chosen
form.descriptionHint: What the client said, in their words. It is used later to draft the vacancy.
form.descriptionPlaceholder: What problem the client has and what they expect from us
form.teamHint: Choosing a team opens the position. The allocation is set afterwards, in the Teams view.
form.teamPlaceholder: Choose the team that receives the request
form.technicalReferentHint: Who supports the consultant through ramp-up.
form.technicalReferentPlaceholder: Name of the person in the team
form.allocationNotice: This position's allocation is not decided here. It is set in the <0>Teams</0> view, and without it the request cannot be closed in the last stage.

jobDescriptionSource.anthropic: Last draft generated with the server's model.
jobDescriptionSource.gemini-nano: Last draft generated with the browser's local model.
jobDescriptionSource.reserva: Last draft composed from the fallback text.

form.jobDescriptionPlaceholder: Write it by hand or press “Draft with AI”
form.draftFrom: Generated from the technical profile already defined.
form.feedbackPlaceholder: What the decision was based on
form.buddyPlaceholder: Who supports them through the first two weeks
form.activeSummary: <0>{{name}}</0> is working in <1>{{team}}</1>. The request's flow ended here; from now on it is the person's lifecycle that moves.
form.activeSummaryNoConsultant: The request is closed and the consultant is active in {{team}}.

teams.title: Teams
teams.subtitle: The Delivery Manager's view: which positions are covered, which are still open, and how much allocation each team has committed. A position's allocation is set here, not on the request, and without it the request cannot reach <0>active</0>.
teams.full: The team is full: there is no room left.
teams.free: {{points}} points free, which is room for {{people}} full time.
teams.noPositions: This team has no positions yet.
teams.noAllocationTooltip: While this position has no allocation, the request cannot be closed in the Onboarding stage.
teams.releaseTooltip: Release the position. The request stops meeting the Team stage requirement and will have to be reassigned.

consultant.title: Consultant lifecycle
consultant.subtitle: A person's whole journey after the request: onboarding, ramp-up, productive, review, and exit or rotation. Each step says what it required and when that was met.
consultant.empty: No consultant is active yet. Take a request all the way to the active stage from Requests and they will appear here.
consultant.advancePhase: Close “{{phase}}” and move to the next
consultant.closeDialogDescription: It is recorded in {{name}}'s lifecycle. People Operations closes the exit phase with this note.
consultant.closeDialogPlaceholderRotation: Which team they rotate to and from when
consultant.closeDialogPlaceholderExit: Reason for leaving and their last day
